artifacts.large_file_policy: The GLB is about 15 MB and the scene about 16 MB; both are tracked in Git, following the Kimi, Terra and Fable precedents (a .gitignore exception was added for this run's two files).

harness.auth: Google AI Studio API key stored only in a protected file on the Mac (~/gemini-carbon-test/.api_key, mode 600); isolated HOME (~/gemini-carbon-test/fakehome) with gemini-api-key auth; the owner's existing Gemini CLI settings were not touched
harness.coordinator: Muse (separate session): prepared the workspace, launched and monitored the run, validated and collected the artifacts without changing the entrant's geometry, materials or code
harness.name: Gemini CLI
harness.task_prompt_delivered: The full text of benchmarks/cafe-selfie-v1/prompts/01-procedural.md was passed verbatim as the -p argument; no summary or additional instructions

privacy.note: The collected character.blend and the render PNGs' File text metadata contain an absolute path including the Mac account name (/Users/...), embedded by Blender at render/save time. The same kind of path is already present in the published Kimi and Terra collections; the artifacts are collected unmodified, as with those runs. The Fable 5.2 run has no such path because the entrant's own build script removed it before saving.

publication.commit_push_and_pull_request: By the coordinator session, at the repository owner's instruction on 2026-11-11.

photo-textured.note: Not executed in this run; whether to run the second stage is the owner's decision.

usage_and_cost_estimate.pricing_basis: Introductory pricing until 2026-11-30: input $2 / output $10 / cached input $0.10 per 1M tokens; JPY at 158 per USD. Estimate computed by the coordinator from the Gemini CLI session stats.

utility_model_gemini-3-flash-preview.note: Used internally by Gemini CLI; a few JPY at most.

procedural.rebuilt_five_pngs_note: Rebuilt PNGs match the originals in dimensions and file size within 0.1%, but their IDAT pixel data is not byte-identical (render noise). This differs from the Fable 5.2 run, where pixel data was byte-identical.

verification.validation_first_attempt: Aborted at the privacy-scan step because zstd was not on PATH; rerun with Homebrew on PATH completed all steps. No effect on the collected artifacts.
verification.viewer_checks: All paths referenced by the gemini-4-carbon entry in viewer/results.json were verified to exist on disk; no real-browser UI check was performed for this run.
